useCases.title: Console Login Without MFA
useCases.value: Console access without MFA is a security risk — compromised passwords alone can grant full account access. Most compliance frameworks require MFA.

useCases.title: Brute-Force Login Detection
useCases.value: Brute-force attacks are a primary credential compromise vector. Early detection prevents account takeover.

useCases.title: MFA Challenge Failure Rate
useCases.value: High MFA failure rates indicate user friction, potential phishing, or MFA fatigue attacks. Monitoring supports both security and user experience.

useCases.title: Dependency Vulnerability Alerts
useCases.value: Vulnerable dependencies in the software supply chain are a primary attack vector. Tracking ensures timely patching.

useCases.title: Major Incident and Post-Mortem Tracking
useCases.value: Tracking major incidents and post-mortem completion ensures learning and accountability. Supports compliance and continuous improvement.

useCases.title: VPN Authentication Failures
useCases.value: Repeated VPN auth failures indicate credential attacks against the remote access perimeter, a primary attack vector.
